d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 자다 attaches -아야겠다 to express an immediate decision: I should sleep.

d9b7a11f37288e1b.zh: 「자야겠었어요」時態重複疊加，是不正確的文法形態。
d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 자야겠었어요 combines tense markers unnaturally and is grammatically incorrect.

d9b7a11f37288e1b.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 뻔하다」表示差點發生某事，意為「差點睡著」。
d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 잘 뻔했어요 means almost fell asleep, which does not fit deciding to sleep.

d9b7a11f37288e1b.zh: 「-기로 되다」表示客觀決定或安排，不符合個人的當下決心。
d9b7a11f37288e1b.en: 자기로 됐어요 means it has been arranged that I sleep, not a personal decision.

d9fb49e29e315cc9.zh: 表示決定做某事時，動詞詞幹接「-기로 하다」。
d9fb49e29e315cc9.en: Correct. -기로 하다 attaches to verb stems to express a decision or plan.

d9fb49e29e315cc9.zh: 「가로」缺少名詞形字尾「-기」，文法不完整。
d9fb49e29e315cc9.en: 가로 lacks the nominalizer -기 needed for the construction -기로 하다.

d9fb49e29e315cc9.zh: 「가기를」接受格助詞，無法與「하다」構成此句型。
d9fb49e29e315cc9.en: 가기를 uses the object marker 를, which does not form the set pattern -기로 하다.

d9fb49e29e315cc9.zh: 「가게」是使動或目的副詞形，不能接「했어요」。
d9fb49e29e315cc9.en: 가게 expresses purpose or manner, not a decision with 하다.

daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 正確。「-기는 하다」表示承認事實但有轉折，接詞幹成「비싸기는」。
daef0afbfecf6153.en: Correct. The pattern -기는 하다 concedes a point before contrasting it.

daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 「-는데」本身就是轉折連接詞尾，後面不能再接「하지만」。
daef0afbfecf6153.en: The connective -는데 already means but and cannot precede 하지만.

daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 「-거나」表示「或者」，與句型「-기는 하다」不合且文意不通。
daef0afbfecf6153.en: The ending -거나 means or, which does not fit the pattern -기는 하다.

daef0afbfecf6153.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中斷轉換，不能與「하지만」組合成轉折句型。
daef0afbfecf6153.en: The ending -다가 indicates an interrupted action and cannot pair with 하지만.

dafbf527a8bc595f.en: The stem of 하다 ends in a vowel, so it correctly takes -ㄹ수록.

dafbf527a8bc595f.zh: 詞幹無收音時不應加「으」，「하을수록」為錯誤形態。
dafbf527a8bc595f.en: Stems without a final consonant take -ㄹ수록, not -을수록.

dafbf527a8bc595f.zh: 此句型無「-는수록」的接續形式，屬錯誤文法形態。
dafbf527a8bc595f.en: There is no ending -는수록; -ㄹ수록 is required here.

dafbf527a8bc595f.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ수록」表示漸進變化，一般不與過去式結合。
dafbf527a8bc595f.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ수록 expresses progressive change and is not used with the past tense.

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 正確。動詞現在式修飾名詞接「-는」，構成「먹는 편이다」。
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: Correct. Action verbs take -는 in the present tense before 편이다.

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 「먹은」表示過去發生過，不適用於表示一般習慣傾向的「편이다」。
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: The past modifier 먹은 indicates a completed event, not a habitual tendency.

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 「먹을」表示未來或推測，不能用來描述日常的飲食習慣。
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: The future modifier 먹을 indicates conjecture, which does not fit general habits.

dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.zh: 「먹어」是非敬語終結形，不能用來修飾後面的依託名詞「편」。
dc9d1dbc38bc37cd.en: The conjugated form 먹어 cannot modify the dependent noun 편.

dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 使動句型「-게 하다」接在動詞幹「읽-」後，表示讓學生讀。
dcc5ba312d99b289.en: The causative pattern -게 하다 directly attaches -게 to the stem 읽-.

dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 使動動詞「읽히다」後不需再疊加「했어요」，且句型要求接「-게」。
dcc5ba312d99b289.en: 읽혀 cannot precede 했어요 in this causative structure requiring -게.

dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 「-어 하다」表示對他人感情的描寫，不能形成「讓…做」的使動。
dcc5ba312d99b289.en: 읽어 했어요 is ungrammatical; -어 하다 does not create a causative meaning.

dcc5ba312d99b289.zh: 「-기 하다」通常用於強調副詞「-기는 하다」，非使動句型。
dcc5ba312d99b289.en: 읽기 does not form a causative construction with 하다 here.

dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절하다」是形容詞，修飾名詞的現在式冠形詞尾接「-ㄴ」。
dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절하다 is an adjective ending in a vowel, so it takes the adjective modifier -ㄴ.

dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절하는」把形容詞誤用了動詞的現在式冠形詞尾「-는」。
dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절하는 incorrectly applies the verb modifier -는 to an adjective.

dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절할」是未來或推測冠形詞尾，不符合描述已具備特徵的句意。
dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절할 conveys future tense or speculation rather than a present quality.

dd6c4d1698347f94.zh: 「친절해」是非格式體終結形，無法直接修飾名詞「데」。
dd6c4d1698347f94.en: 친절해 is an informal sentence-ending form and cannot modify the noun 데.

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 文法「-(으)ㄴ/는 데다가」常與後句的「도」（也）呼應。
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 도 pairs naturally with -(으)ㄴ/는 데다가 to add another point meaning also.

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 「은」是主題標詞，在此處無法像「도」一樣表達「再加上」的語氣。
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 은 is a topic marker and lacks the additive meaning of also required here.

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 「만」表示「只有、僅僅」，與句型疊加特性的邏輯矛盾。
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 만 means only, contradicting the cumulative meaning of on top of that.

dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.zh: 「을」是受格標詞，「바람이 불다」中風是主語，不能接受格。
dd9d5cab1b7c60b2.en: 을 is an object marker, but 바람 (wind) is the subject of 불다 (blow).

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「에 따라」接在名詞後，表示「隨著、因人而異」，符合句意。
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 에 따라 attaches to nouns to mean depending on, perfectly fitting opinions differing by person.

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「을 따라」是跟隨具體對象或沿著道路的意思，文法與語意不合。
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 을 따라 means following along someone or a physical path, which does not fit here.

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「에 비해」表示「與……相比」，是用來比較兩者，非因人而異。
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 에 비해 means compared to and indicates comparison rather than variation depending on the person.

ddf90876bd9c0d3f.zh: 「대신」表示「代替、反而」，與前後文的語意不符。
ddf90876bd9c0d3f.en: 대신 means instead of or in place of, which does not fit the context.

de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 「자마자」接在詞幹데뷔하-後，表示一出道就變有名了。
de79a1793c1c521d.en: 자마자 attaches to the stem 데뷔하- to mean became famous as soon as debuting.

de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 「다가」表示出道動作進行到一半中斷，不符合句意邏輯。
de79a1793c1c521d.en: 다가 implies an action interrupted mid-way, which does not fit becoming famous after debuting.

de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 題幹已有하，「는 동안」會變成데뷔하는 동안，表出道過程中。
de79a1793c1c521d.en: With 는 동안, the sentence would say while debuting, rather than right after debut.

de79a1793c1c521d.zh: 「거나」表示或者，表選擇關係，與出道後成名的先後因果不符。
de79a1793c1c521d.en: 거나 means or, expressing an alternative rather than immediate consequence.

df568287073dbbd2.zh: 形容詞「춥다」表示性質轉變時，應使用「-아/어지다」形成「추워졌어요」。
df568287073dbbd2.en: 추워졌어요 uses -아/어지다 on the adjective 춥다 to naturally describe weather turning cold.

df568287073dbbd2.zh: 形容詞通常用「-아/어지다」表變化，「춥게 됐어요」語感生硬且不自然。
df568287073dbbd2.en: 춥게 됐어요 is unnatural; adjectives describing natural changes generally take -아/어지다, not -게 되다.

df568287073dbbd2.zh: 「추워 있어요」不符合韓語習慣，形容詞無法與「-어 있다」連用表狀態。
df568287073dbbd2.en: 추워 있어요 is grammatically invalid because -아/어 있다 only pairs with intransitive verbs.

df568287073dbbd2.zh: 「춥고 있어요」文法錯誤，「-고 있다」不能接在形容詞「춥다」後。
df568287073dbbd2.en: 춥고 있어요 is incorrect because the progressive marker -고 있다 cannot attach to adjectives.

df589e50eba448a0.zh: 正確。-(으)ㄹ 텐데 放在句中表示預期情況的轉折或背景說明。
df589e50eba448a0.en: Correct. -(으)ㄹ 텐데 provides context expressing a presupposition or regret.

df589e50eba448a0.zh: 「덕분에」表示「多虧……」，不能接在 -았/었을 之後。
df589e50eba448a0.en: 덕분에 means thanks to and does not follow the future-retrospective form.

df589e50eba448a0.zh: 「바람에」表示「因為（消極原因）」，通常接在動詞 -는 之後。
df589e50eba448a0.en: 바람에 means as a result of (negative) and takes -는, not -(으)ㄹ.

df589e50eba448a0.zh: 「동안」表示「期間」，接在 -(으)ㄹ 後語義不通。
df589e50eba448a0.en: 동안 means during or while, which makes no sense in this context.

e29a35ac49334613.zh: 根據路面濕推測「下過雨」，動詞過去推測接「-(으)ㄴ 모양이다」，選「온」。
e29a35ac49334613.en: To infer a past action from evidence, verbs take -(으)ㄴ 모양이다; 오다 becomes 온.

e29a35ac49334613.zh: 「오는 모양이다」表示推測「正在下雨」，與昨晚下過雨的情境不符。
e29a35ac49334613.en: 오는 모양이다 would mean it seems to be raining right now, not last night.

e29a35ac49334613.zh: 「올 모양이다」表示推測「將要下雨」，無法解釋地上已經濕了的痕跡。
e29a35ac49334613.en: 올 모양이다 implies a future prediction (it will rain), which conflicts with the wet road.

e29a35ac49334613.zh: 「와」是非格式體非敬語詞尾，不能直接修飾名詞「모양」。
e29a35ac49334613.en: 와 is an informal verb ending and cannot directly modify 모양.

e4822bef692cc4b8.zh: 正確。-(으)ㄹ지도 固定搭配 모르다（몰라요）表示「可能……」。
e4822bef692cc4b8.en: Correct. The pattern -(으)ㄹ지도 pairs with 모르다 (몰라요) to mean might.

e4822bef692cc4b8.zh: 「알아요」表示知道，不可與 -(으)ㄹ지도 搭配表達可能推測。
e4822bef692cc4b8.en: 알아요 means to know and does not form this guessing grammar.

e4822bef692cc4b8.zh: 「있어요」表示存在或有，不能接在 -(으)ㄹ지도 後面。
e4822bef692cc4b8.en: 있어요 means exist/have and cannot follow -(으)ㄹ지도.
돼요 means to become or be okay and cannot follow -(으)ㄹ지도.

e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「말이 나온 김에」是固定慣用語，表示「既然話都說到這了」。
e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나온 forms the set phrase 말이 나온 김에, meaning while we are on the topic.

e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「나오」只是動詞詞幹，不能直接修飾依存名詞김에。
e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나오 is just the verb stem and cannot modify the dependent noun 김.

e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「나와」是動詞的不規則活用基底，無法直接作冠形詞修飾名詞。
e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나와 is a conjugated stem/ending, not an adnominal form that can modify 김에.

e58e0fe3b37ba944.zh: 「나올」表將來，但話已經說出口了，必須用過去冠形詞나온。
e58e0fe3b37ba944.en: 나올 is future-oriented, but the phrase requires the past modifier 나온 since words have already emerged.

e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「하느라고」接動詞詞幹，表示因忙於某事而導致後面的負面結果。
e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: 하느라고 attaches to a verb stem to indicate that spending effort on doing something caused a negative result.

e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「-느라고」前不可加過去式標記「-었/았-」，此形態錯誤。
e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: Past tense markers like -었/았- cannot attach before -느라고, so 했느라고 is ungrammatical.

e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「하려고」表示意圖「為了做」，無法接續後方的消極結果。
e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: 하려고 expresses an intention or purpose (in order to do) rather than explaining a negative consequence.

e67c1a9171b33fa0.zh: 「하도록」表示目的或使動「為了讓…」，語意在此不通順。
e67c1a9171b33fa0.en: 하도록 means so that or to the extent that, which does not fit giving an excuse for a negative outcome.

e767ba44ba2e44a4.zh: 否定形「-지 않다」接「-도록」形成「-지 않도록」，意為「為了不…」。
e767ba44ba2e44a4.en: -지 않도록 is the standard negative form meaning so as not to or in order not to.

e767ba44ba2e44a4.zh: 韓語中無「-게도록」這種雙重副詞形接尾的文法形式。
「말다」用於禁止命令句，在一般修飾副詞子句中應使用「않다」。
e767ba44ba2e44a4.en: 말다 is used in prohibitions like -지 마세요, not as a standard subordinate clause here.

e767ba44ba2e44a4.zh: 「못하다」表示能力不足，與「조심하다」搭配常規否定應用「않다」。
e767ba44ba2e44a4.en: 못하다 expresses inability; ordinary negative prevention with 조심하세요 uses 않도록.

e92e29ddd32d6277.en: The stem 오- combines with -아도 to contract into 와도, meaning even if it rains.
오- and -아도 must contract into 와; 오아도 is not used.

e92e29ddd32d6277.zh: 讓步句型需接「-아/어도」，「오도」缺少連接元音아。
e92e29ddd32d6277.en: The concessive ending requires -아/어도; 오도 lacks the connecting vowel 아.

e92e29ddd32d6277.zh: 「-(으)면」表假設「如果下雨」，無法表達即使下雨之讓步感。
e92e29ddd32d6277.en: 오면 means if it rains, expressing a condition rather than concession.

eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 名詞「밥」後直接加「대신(에)」，表示「代替米飯」。
eb374da39db4b9ed.en: The noun 밥 attaches directly to 대신 to mean instead of rice.

eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 韓語名詞接「대신」時直接相連，不習慣加上所有格助詞「의」。
eb374da39db4b9ed.en: Korean nouns attach directly to 대신 without the possessive marker 의.

eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 「-는 대신」用於動詞詞幹之後，名詞「밥」後不可接「는」。
eb374da39db4b9ed.en: -는 대신 is used with verb stems, not directly after nouns like 밥.

eb374da39db4b9ed.zh: 「대로」接在名詞後表示「按照…」，不符合吃麵包代替飯的語意。
eb374da39db4b9ed.en: 대로 means in accordance with or as, which does not mean instead of.

eb4372922e99f1c1.en: 하다 combines with -아야/어야겠다 to become 해야겠어요 (I should do).
하야겠어요 is an incorrect conjugation of 하다 with -아야/어야겠다.

eb4372922e99f1c1.zh: 「해야겠었요」拼寫與時態形態錯誤，正確結尾為「-어요」。
eb4372922e99f1c1.en: 해야겠었요 is a misspelling and grammatically malformed ending.

eb4372922e99f1c1.zh: 「하겠어야요」語尾接續順序完全錯誤，沒有這種文法結構。
eb4372922e99f1c1.en: 하겠어야요 has an incorrect order of endings and is ungrammatical.

ebd7d2b3f36e9ef5.zh: 正確。動詞無尾音接「-면서」表示同時進行兩件事。
ebd7d2b3f36e9ef5.en: Correct. Verb stems without a final consonant take -면서 to express simultaneous actions.
마시으면서 is wrong because stems without a final consonant do not take 으.

ebd7d2b3f36e9ef5.zh: 「마셔면서」不應將詞幹變為非格式體「-어」形。
ebd7d2b3f36e9ef5.en: 마셔면서 incorrectly conjugates to the -어 stem before -면서.
마실면서 incorrectly inserts the future/prospective ㄹ.

ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 正確。形容詞「크다」無終聲尾音，修飾名詞接「-ㄴ 편이다」。
ec25edf5f7609300.en: Correct. The adjective 크다 ends in a vowel, so it takes -ㄴ to become 큰 편이에요.

ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 「크다」在此為形容詞表示個子高，修飾名詞不可接「-는」。
ec25edf5f7609300.en: When describing height, 크다 is an adjective and cannot take -는.

ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 「클」表示未來或推測，不能用來描述目前的身高特徵。
ec25edf5f7609300.en: The prospective form 클 implies future or conjecture, not current height.

ec25edf5f7609300.zh: 「커」是非敬語口語終結形，無法直接修飾名詞「편」。
ec25edf5f7609300.en: The informal ending 커 cannot be used as a modifier before 편.

ed5def31a44816cb.zh: 形容詞「예쁘다」無收音，現在式定語接「-ㄴ」成為「예쁜」。
ed5def31a44816cb.en: Adjectives without a final consonant take -ㄴ to form a present modifier, making 예쁜 correct.

ed5def31a44816cb.zh: 「-는 것 같다」通常用於動詞，形容詞現在推測應接「-(으)ㄴ」。
ed5def31a44816cb.en: Adjectives take -(으)ㄴ rather than -는 when forming present tense modifiers with 것 같다.

ed5def31a44816cb.zh: 定語詞尾不加在非語幹的活用形「예뻐」後，「예뻐는」形態錯誤。
ed5def31a44816cb.en: Modifier endings attach directly to the adjective stem 예쁘-, not to conjugated forms like 예뻐.

ed5def31a44816cb.zh: 「예쁠는」是錯誤疊加未來與現在詞尾的非正規形態。
ed5def31a44816cb.en: 예쁠는 incorrectly combines future and present endings and does not exist in Korean.

ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 老師要求交作業是命令句，口語轉述縮略形用「-(으)래요」，故選「내래요」。
ee49dc6639f90860.en: The teacher is commanding homework submission; reported commands casually shorten to -(으)래요.

ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 「낸대요」是陳述句轉述（-ㄴ다고 해요），意思會變成老師說他自己要交作業。
ee49dc6639f90860.en: 낸대요 reports a statement (says they submit), not an instruction to students.

ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 「내재요」是提議句轉述縮略形（-자고 해요），意思是提議「一起交吧」。
ee49dc6639f90860.en: 내재요 reports a suggestion (short for -자고 해요, let's submit), not a teacher's directive.

ee49dc6639f90860.zh: 「내냬요」是疑問句轉述縮略形（-냐고 해요），意思是詢問「要不要交」。
ee49dc6639f90860.en: 내냬요 reports a question (short for -냐고 해요, asks if you submit), not a command.

eec83a09f38bf623.zh: 「말했잖아요」是過去式，提醒對方「我昨天不是說過了嗎？」。
eec83a09f38bf623.en: 말했잖아요 uses past tense to remind the listener of what you told them yesterday.

eec83a09f38bf623.zh: 「말하잖아요」是現在式，與表示昨天的「어제」時態不符。
eec83a09f38bf623.en: 말하잖아요 is present tense, which clashes with 어제 (yesterday).

eec83a09f38bf623.zh: 「말할잖아요」是不合文法的錯誤形態，將來式不可這樣接續。
「말하자고요」表示引用「我們說好要說」，文意不符。
eec83a09f38bf623.en: 말하자고요 means let's say or quotes a proposal, unfitting here.

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-더라도」接動詞詞幹，表「即使（考試）落榜」的假設讓步。
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -더라도 attaches to 떨어지- to express a hypothetical concession: even if I fail.

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-느라고」表為了做某事而導致負面結果，不符此處假設語境。
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -느라고 indicates that an action caused a negative result, which does not fit here.

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-자마자」表示「一…就…」，不符後句「不會失望」的邏輯。
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -자마자 means as soon as, which does not fit the intended concession.

ef2fc102a9f6eccb.zh: 「-(으)려고」表意圖或目的「為了落榜」，語義完全不合理。
ef2fc102a9f6eccb.en: -(으)려고 expresses intention or purpose (in order to fail), which makes no sense.

efa83390b1a6cc67.zh: 名詞「방학」直接加上「동안」即可表示「在放假期間」。
efa83390b1a6cc67.en: 동안 directly attaches to nouns like 방학 to mean during the vacation.

efa83390b1a6cc67.zh: 「의 동안」多加了助詞의，韓文名詞後直接接동안即可。
efa83390b1a6cc67.en: 의 동안 unnecessarily adds 의; nouns attach directly to 동안 without a particle.

efa83390b1a6cc67.zh: 「는 동안」前面只能接動詞詞幹，不能直接接在名詞後面。
efa83390b1a6cc67.en: 는 동안 must attach to verb stems, not directly to a noun like 방학.

efa83390b1a6cc67.zh: 「에서」是表示地點的助詞，不能接在時間名詞放假後面表期間。
efa83390b1a6cc67.en: 에서 is a location particle, so it cannot attach to a time noun like 방학.

efab6698ead67262.en: Correct. 따뜻하다 combines with -아/어지다 to become 따뜻해지다.
하다 irregular verbs conjugate to 해, not 하어.

efab6698ead67262.zh: 「-게 되다」強調被動的轉變，而非形容詞本身的狀態變化。
efab6698ead67262.en: -게 되다 indicates a change in circumstances or external results rather than gradual change.

efab6698ead67262.zh: 「-어 있다」通常用於動詞表示狀態持續，不可用於形容詞。
efab6698ead67262.en: -어 있다 expresses a continuous state for verbs, not adjectives.

f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 正確。前後語意轉折，且後句為過去未完成，故選過去轉折形「했는데」。
f16f4961554ec5af.en: Correct. It contrasts past action with the result using the past connective 했는데.

f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 「하는데요」是句子終結敬語形式，不能放在句中連接下文。
f16f4961554ec5af.en: The sentence-ending form 하는데요 cannot connect two clauses within a sentence.

f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 「했으면」表示假設「如果做了的話」，不符合後句轉折的語境。
f16f4961554ec5af.en: The conditional 했으면 means if I did, which contradicts the contrasting context.

f16f4961554ec5af.zh: 「하려고」表示意圖「打算做」，與後句「沒能全部做完」無法搭配。
f16f4961554ec5af.en: The intention suffix 하려고 means in order to do, which does not make sense here.

f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋다」是形容詞詞幹，有收音接「-을 뿐만 아니라」。
f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋다 has a final consonant, so it correctly takes -을 뿐만 아니라.

f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋은」是一般形容詞冠形詞形，但該句型固定要求接「-(으)ㄹ」。
f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋은 is the standard modifier for adjectives, but this pattern requires -(으)ㄹ.

f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋는」文法錯誤，形容詞不能接動詞冠形詞尾「-는」。
f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋는 is ungrammatical; adjectives cannot take the verb modifier suffix -는.

f214d5251ebc5915.zh: 「좋아」是口語終結詞尾，不能直接接名詞「뿐」。
f214d5251ebc5915.en: 좋아 is an informal ending and cannot grammatically connect to 뿐.

f4025c6a701add3c.en: 먹이다 is the causative of 먹다, meaning to feed someone.

f4025c6a701add3c.zh: 「먹었어요」為主動形，會變成媽媽自己吃了飯，而非餵小孩。
f4025c6a701add3c.en: 먹었어요 is active, meaning Mom ate the food herself.

f4025c6a701add3c.zh: 「먹혔어요」是被動形，表示媽媽被飯吃掉，意思荒謬。
f4025c6a701add3c.en: 먹혔어요 is passive, which would absurdly mean Mom was eaten by food.
먹겼어요 is incorrect; 먹다 takes the causative suffix -이-, not -기-.

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 正確。形容詞「조용하다」以母音結尾，接「-ㄴ 편이다」。
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: Correct. The adjective 조용하다 ends in a vowel and takes -ㄴ to modify 편.

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 「조용하다」是形容詞，修飾名詞時不可接動詞專用的「-는」。
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: Adjectives do not take the present modifier -는; 조용하는 is ungrammatical.

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 「조용할」表示未來推測，不能用來客觀描述社區平時的特點。
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: The future modifier 조용할 expresses supposition, not a general tendency.

f5bc25aa3e30ed70.zh: 「조용해」是句子結尾的非敬語形式，不能直接修飾名詞「편」。
f5bc25aa3e30ed70.en: The conjugated form 조용해 cannot directly modify the noun 편.

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「보느라」是「보느라고」的縮略形，表示因追劇而沒能做作業。
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: 보느라 is the shortened form of 보느라고, correctly expressing that watching drama caused failing to do homework.

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「-느라(고)」前不能加過去式標記「-었/았-」，形態錯誤。
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: Past tense markers cannot precede -느라(고), making 봤느라 grammatically incorrect.

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「보러」表示移動的目的「去看」，通常搭配「가다/오다」。
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: 보러 means in order to see and must be followed by movement verbs like 가다 or 오다.

f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.zh: 「보려면」表示假設意圖「如果想要看的話」，語意不符。
f89ef32ffe7c9dc0.en: 보려면 means if you intend to watch, which sets up a condition rather than explaining an excuse.

fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 正確。「-다가」直接接原形詞幹「걷-」，表示走路途中跌倒。
fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: Correct. -다가 attaches directly to the basic stem 걷- without ㄷ irregular change.

fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 「걸다가」錯誤將「걷다」變音，接輔音開頭的「-다가」不變音。
fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: 걸다가 mistakenly applies the ㄷ irregular change before the consonant -다가.

fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 「걸었다가」強調走完後才跌倒，無法表達「走路進行中跌倒」。
fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: 걸었다가 implies finishing the walk before falling, losing the sense of falling mid-action.

fb3b4342ec9a4162.zh: 「걸으러」表示「為了去散步/走路」，表示目的，與句意不符。
fb3b4342ec9a4162.en: 걸으러 expresses purpose ('in order to walk'), which does not fit.

fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 正確。表示對過去已發生事情的推測，使用 -았/었을지도 몰라요。
fe9c052f75ae4162.en: Correct. For a guess about a past event, use -았/었을지도 몰라요.

fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 「떠날지도는」後面多接了助詞 는，且為未來式，與 벌써 不合。
fe9c052f75ae4162.en: 떠날지도는 has an unnecessary topic marker 는 and is not past tense.

fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 「떠나을지도」拼寫錯誤，無收音詞幹過去式應為 떠났-。
fe9c052f75ae4162.en: 떠나을지도 is an ungrammatical spelling; past stems require -았/었-.

fe9c052f75ae4162.zh: 「떠난지도」表示自從離開之後的時間，無法搭配 몰라요 表示可能。
fe9c052f75ae4162.en: 떠난지도 indicates time elapsed since leaving, not uncertain possibility.
